sections.title: Home
sections.subtitle: Everyday house services — internet, power, pool, media, print.

items.name: Internet (ISP)
items.blurb: Fidium fiber (AS14051) — outbound path health from the lab.
items.help: WAN egress ~156.47.77.110 via Fidium. Typical latency ~8ms to 1.1.1.1; TCP check is Cloudflare :443. Sample CF download ~650 Mbps from this host.

items.name: Tesla Energy
items.blurb: Tesla Powerwall local gateway — battery / home energy on the house network.
items.help: Local UI at tesla.dataknife.net. Meter APIs need login/token; HA core Tesla integration was removed — use Tesla app or Fleet API for live SoC.

items.name: Enphase Envoy
items.blurb: Solar production gateway on the house network (envoy.local).
items.help: Official Home Assistant integration: enphase_envoy. Local /info answers without login; live production needs Enphase token or installer password.

items.name: Pool · WaterGuru / Hayward
items.blurb: Pool chemistry (WaterGuru cloud) and equipment (Hayward OmniLogic on omnilogic.local).
items.help: WaterGuru: HACS cloud integrations (prefer igorek24/waterguru-home-assistant; older dwradcliffe needs pycognito fix). Hayward: official HA omnilogic (cloud) or cryptk/haomnilogic-local (UDP 10444 on LAN).

items.name: Lutron
items.blurb: Lutron Smart Bridge — lights and scenes on the house network.
items.help: LEAP on Lutron-01f3741d.local:8081. Pair via Lutron app or Home Assistant Lutron Caseta.

items.name: SmartThings
items.blurb: Samsung SmartThings hub — house automations and sensors.
items.help: Hub answers on hubv3-03011283166.local. Use the SmartThings app for routines.

items.name: Sign in
items.blurb: One login for most home and lab websites.
items.help: If login fails, note the error and ask whoever runs Authentik.

items.name: Plex (lab)
items.blurb: Media on the home network — movies, shows, and more.
items.help: Use this when you are on the lab network. Prefer Plex (app) when away.

items.name: Brother printer
items.blurb: Brother HL-L2460DW — lab network printer (AirPrint / IPP).
items.help: Host: BRW502E6685EFE7.local · IPP: ipp://BRW502E6685EFE7.local/ipp/print

connect.windows: Settings → Printers & scanners → Add device (or Add manually → IPP URL http://BRW502E6685EFE7.local:631/ipp/print)

items.name: TrueNAS
items.blurb: Storage admin for pools, datasets, and apps on the NAS.
items.help: For missing media libraries or full disks, start here.

items.name: Object storage
items.blurb: NAS / RustFS — S3-style buckets for apps and backups.
items.help: If an app cannot write objects, confirm this endpoint first.

items.name: Workspaces
items.blurb: Coder — browser IDEs and agent berths.
items.help: If a workspace will not start, check Coder then the cluster.

items.name: Pulseblade
items.blurb: Infra findings and remediation when something is wrong.
items.help: Open for the story behind a red DockFire tile.

items.name: Container registry
items.blurb: Harbor — private images the clusters pull.
items.help: Deploy failures that say image pull often start here.

items.name: Kubernetes manager
items.blurb: Rancher — clusters, nodes, and GitOps targets.
items.help: Use when a whole cluster looks unhealthy.

items.name: Proxmox
items.blurb: Hypervisor for VMs and containers that back the lab.
items.help: Power guests and node maintenance live here.

sections.title: Game servers
sections.subtitle: Dedicated servers on the lab. Ask an admin for join passwords — never share admin credentials.

items.name: Palworld
items.blurb: Dedicated Palworld world (Kubernetes operator).
items.help: In-game: Join Multiplayer Game → direct connect. Use the join password (server-password), not admin-password.
items.adminDetail: https://palworld.dataknife.net/ — basic auth user admin (operators only)

items.name: Windrose
items.blurb: Windrose dedicated server.
items.help: In-game: Play → Connect to Server. Direct connect uses host:port; invite-code mode is operator-configured.

items.name: Satisfactory
items.blurb: Satisfactory dedicated server.
items.help: In-game: Server Manager → Add Server → enter host and port 7777.
